source.title: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section II - Materials, Part D - Properties (Metric)
source.note: Technical content only. Publisher front/back matter, running heads and printed folios are omitted. Values are as printed; the ASME ellipsis (no value / not permitted) is represented as null. NP = Not Permitted and SPT = Supports Only are kept verbatim where printed.

title: Factors for Limiting Permanent Strain in Austenitic Stainless Steels, High-Nickel Alloy Steels, Nickel, Nickel Alloys, Copper, and Copper Alloys
notes: GENERAL NOTE: This Table lists multiplying factors that, when applied to the yield strength values shown in Table Y‐1, will give a value that will result in lower levels of permanent strain. If this value is less than the maximum allowable stress value listed in Table 1A, Table 1B, Table 2A, Table 2B, Table 5A, or Table 5B, or the design stress intensity value listed in Table 2A or Table 2B, the lower value shall be used.
